newsitem.title: USA: Office Depot stock falls in after-hours.
newsitem.headline: Office Depot stock falls in after-hours.

text.p: Office supplies superstore Office Depot Inc saw its stock fall to 14-1/2 in after-hours trading from a close of 19-7/16 following a court decision blocking its merger with Staples Inc, dealers said Monday.
One trader said he had yet to see any trading in Staples, which was at 23-1/4 before it was halted for trading earlier in the afternoon in anticipation of the court ruling.
U.S. District Judge Thomas Hogan granted the government a preliminary injunction halting the $4 billion merger between the two companies.
The Federal Trade Commission had argued the combined chains would have the power to raise consumer prices.
After the court ruling, a lawyer for Staples said the company would decide within four days whether to appeal the decision.
Meanwhile, Office Depot said it would decide in a "few days" whether to appeal, saying the decision meant the merger was unlikely.
